chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

Abu Al-Hasan Al-Reza (peace be upon him) said: 'From the signs of the understanding (fiqh) are forbearance, knowledge, and silence. Indeed, silence is a door from the doors of wisdom. Indeed, silence acquires love. Indeed, it is a pointer upon every goodness.'

key_terms.الْفِقْهُ: Understanding/Deep knowledge in a religious context

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of true religious understanding (fiqh) according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) expands the concept of *fiqh* beyond mere legal knowledge to include moral virtues like forbearance (*hilm*) and silence (*samt*). He characterizes silence not merely as absence of speech, but as an active gateway to wisdom and a social catalyst for gaining affection, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the integration of inner piety and outward conduct. This teaching underscores that true religious understanding manifests in self-restraint, which serves as a comprehensive indicator of moral excellence.
